ValidationRule.description: This validation rule avoid change the payment method when contract is anyone of these status: Finalized, Cancelled or Payment Rejection.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Finalized'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Cancelled'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Payment Rejection') ), ISCHANGED(SM_Payment_Method__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can't change the payment method in this contract status
